question:
Consider the function \(f(t)=e^{-1/t}\), \(t>0\). Let for each positive integer \(n\), \(P_n\) be the polynomial such that
\[
\frac{d^n}{dt^n}f(t)=P_n(1/t)e^{-1/t}
\]
for all \(t>0\). Show that
\[
P_{n+1}(x)=x^2\left(P_n(x)-\frac{d}{dx}P_n(x)\right).
\]

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
